verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in web development UI explicitly for testing, evaluating, and debugging agents, and provides callbacks/hooks for logging and monitoring during execution, which together support inspecting agent runs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated trace view showing every LLM call and tool invocation (e.g., span-level tracing, OpenTelemetry integration) — missing for 10: explicit trace/span UI for LLM calls and tool invocations, integration with standard observability backends, and independent hands-on confirmation of trace granularity.
